The image shows a single leaf that is:
- Completely brown/dead, uniformly desiccated
- Severely curled/twisted, with a distorted shape
- No green tissue remaining
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No black sooty surface deposit (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No distinct necrotic lesions with defined margins (less typical of Anthracnose)
- The leaf has died back entirely from the tip downward, consistent with Die Back — a condition where shoot/leaf tissue dies progressively from the tip, leaving a completely desiccated, curled, brown structure
